name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Pistol goes with exactly two of Fairfax, Blackmail, and Doctor.
Fairfax goes with Jealousy if and only if Doctor does not go with Secrecy.
Jealousy goes with Heir if and only if Secrecy does not go with Doctor.
Either Butler goes with Poison or Holloway goes with Heir.
Spite goes with exactly two of Pierce, Poison, and Doctor.
Pistol, Poison, and Spanner go with Doctor, Heir, and Maid, in some order.
